{"value":"{\"id\":7540640186465,\"title\":\"Perfect Helen 30\",\"handle\":\"perfect-helen-30-light-mocha-crosta\",\"description\":\"

The Perfect Helen 30 in Light Mocha Crosta is a new ankle boot from the Perfect Collection, set on a 30mm (1.2\\\") block heel and crafted in soft Italian crosta suede. Panels of a classic Irish chevron are set into the shaft, while a sculptural buckle strap wraps the ankle for a look that feels rooted in heritage yet entirely new.

\\n

It’s made for full days of fall dressing: over slim jeans, under a wide-leg trouser, or with a midi skirt and opaque tights. A functional interior zipper lets it slip on and off with ease while keeping the exterior clean. The comfort is quietly built in: an inset block heel that shifts weight away from the ball of the foot, arch support, a roomier toe box, a generously padded footbed and heel, and a rubber sole for steady traction.

\\n

Made in Italy. Fits true to size; consider a half size up if wearing thicker socks.
